# Pixel Interval Trainer

A tiny offline interval timer built with plain HTML, CSS and JavaScript.

## Features

- Set work seconds, rest seconds and number of rounds.
- Start counts down through each work phase, then rest, for every round.
- Displays the current phase (Work/Rest), remaining seconds and round number.
- Pause/Resume and Stop controls.
- Announces "Workout complete" (on screen and via the Web Speech API when available).
- Keyboard-accessible labeled inputs and buttons.

## Usage

Open `index.html` in any modern browser. No build step, packages, network requests or server required.

## Files

- `index.html` – markup and controls
- `style.css` – theme and layout
- `app.js` – timer logic
